'''Yellow bullheads''' are a type of aquatic [[vermin]] found in [[temperate]] [[water|freshwater]] [[lake]]s year-round, and are a ready source of [[food]] when [[fish cleaning|cleaned]] at a [[fishery]].

Some [[dwarves]] [[Preferences|like]] yellow bullheads for their ''whiskers''.
